why: A test and a generated baseline only: the regexes, the naming rules, the JSON shape, the writer's min() rule and the planted case are all spelled out, and the patterns match the code (adminTexts(lang, areas) at views.tsx line 81 with ["website", "schedules"], 212 literal calls). Wrong code is caught by the brief's own checks: at least 188 sites, the product editor's site between 200,000 and 280,000 bytes, the in-memory planted area, and a stop when more than a third of sites come out whole.
harm_if_wrong: A measuring test that holds slightly wrong byte figures for later cuts; the app and production are untouched and the commit reverts cleanly.
brief_problems: Site ids are positional (<file>#<n>), so any later edit that adds or moves a hand-down above another renumbers sites and forces a baseline rewrite (step 0.10 moving StorePageTermsView out of views.tsx is one).
